measurementMethod: Individual visual inspection of each raw image on a gridded review sheet, converted to 1448x1086 final coordinates. Approximate, not segmentation.
safeZoneNotes: Raw art generated 16:9 with the built-in image tool, then reframed to 4:3: scaled to 1448 wide and anchored at the top (with a small top trim on some pages, see trims); the rows under the caption panel are a soft blurred, dimmed mirror of the foreground. All character bounds above y=760. Cover is a native 4:3 image with the title painted in.
